title: Nicholas W. Campos | Life Tributes | thedesertreview.com
text:
Nicholas W. Campos
Feb. 4, 1983 – May 17, 2026
Our beloved son, Nicholas W. Campos, was called back home by our loving Father on Sunday, May 17, 2026.
Nicholas is survived by his loving wife, Linda; his parents, Eberardo S. Campos and Rosalie C. Campos; his siblings, brother Vincent A. Campos (Nansi), and his sister Elizabeth C. Madarang (David); three beautiful nieces; two wonderful nephews; many loving aunts and uncles; numerous caring and devoted cousins and friends. So much love.
Nicholas was preceded in death by his paternal grandparents, Alfredo Campos and Jesus Campos; maternal grandparents, Emilio Coronado and Berta T. Coronado (Dominguez).
The Lord has also called his beloved cousin, Nanette Medina, and his loving uncle, Phillip Medina, home.
The Lord sent Nicholas to Eberardo and Rosalie on February 4, 1983. He sent them an angel, chubby at just under nine pounds, rosy cheeks and tight curls framing his face.
His journey through this earth began and now ends in eternal joy and, finally, a full and truly abundant life. We rejoice with you, son.
Nicholas attended J.W. Oakley Elementary, Holtville Middle School and graduated from Holtville High School.
Nicholas started working for SEMPRA Southern CA Gas Company in 2006 at the El Centro office as a meter reader. At his passing, he was still with SEMPRA as a drafting engineer out of the Redlands station.
Nicholas had great love for family and friends but recognized that this love is born of God and an extension to others.
Nicholas was greatly touched and moved by those in his family circle and those he met. His heart was easily impacted by others' joys and sorrows.
Nicholas will forever be a part of our lives. He continues to live in our hearts and our memories. Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints. Psalms 116:15.
Church services will begin from 10 a.m. to 12 p.m. on June 19, 2026, at Christ Community Church, located at 572 W. Orange Ave., El Centro, CA 92243.
A celebration of life will take place at Hidalgo Hall located at 410 S. Cesar Chavez St., Brawley, CA 92227, on June 19, 2026 from 1 p.m. to 5 p.m.
